decision: held: record-level scoring_eligible=false hold and Dr. Pham's 2026-10-28 correction hold; the correction notice for 34415830 (PMID 35917215, DOI 10.1080/27697061.2022.2099711, 'Notice of Correction', Table 4) is unreadable: its only open copy (tandfonline.com PDF, listed by OpenAlex/Crossref) returned HTTP 403, PubMed carries no abstract, and it is not in PMC/Europe PMC
summary: The signed record-level scoring_eligible=false hold and Dr. Pham's A135 corrected-table hold both stay. The Alpha Hope trial (38908296) is now verified from full text: PQQ 20 mg with hydrogen-producing magnesium in 34 MCI adults; the primary BDNF interaction was not significant (P=0.14), with large baseline imbalance; approved as a no-credit combination context. The mnemoPQQ trial (34415830) is abstract-only and its Table 4 correction (35917215) could not be retrieved, so its context is written but left pending, with direction unresolved.

identity.standardization: PQQ 20 mg plus dihydrogen-producing elemental magnesium 80 mg per day

population.description: 34 adults aged >=65 with mild cognitive impairment (MMSE <=28; mean age 71.9, 28 women), 18 active and 16 placebo, all analysed.

study_contexts.study_design: Parallel-group, randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind trial, 1:1, 6 weeks; placebo was non-hydrogen-producing magnesium bicarbonate with organic acids.

outcomes.name: Primary BDNF treatment-by-time interaction P=.14, not significant; within-group P=.01 does not establish placebo superiority.
Secondary ADAS-Cog orientation interaction P=.03; not overall cognitive efficacy or isolated-PQQ evidence.
MMSE improved in both groups; treatment-by-time interaction P=0.58. ADAS-Cog domains improved within both groups.

limitations: The elemental magnesium/hydrogen component is part of the active intervention.
The separate corrected-table hold on PMID34415830 remains; this combination trial cannot resolve it.
Returned decision: Corrected-table hold remains; reject combination-to-isolated-PQQ transfer.

Baseline serum BDNF differed markedly between groups (20.9 vs 8.1 ng/mL), further limiting the primary-outcome comparison. Record-level scoring_eligible=false (signed) retained; combination evidence carries no PQQ credit.
Context authored and source-verified by agent review (Claude) on 2026-10-28; Dr. Pham's pre-approval of fully source-verified contexts attested by Sean on 2026-10-28.

dose.administration_frequency: Daily total PQQ 20 mg plus elemental magnesium 80 mg, divided before breakfast and dinner; dissolve each assigned tablet in 250 mL lukewarm water and consume immediately.
co_therapies: Daily elemental magnesium 80 mg is hydrogen-producing active cointervention.
dose.reported_regimen: Daily total PQQ 20 mg plus elemental magnesium 80 mg, divided before breakfast and dinner; dissolve each assigned tablet in 250 mL lukewarm water and consume immediately.

normalization.basis: Preserve the specifically identified material or component quantity; no elemental/marker conversion or extrapolated daily dose.

source_provenance.location: Full text (PMC12878601): Methods (design, eligibility, intervention paragraph, outcomes, statistics); Results Table 2 and cognition paragraph; Discussion.

population.description: 64 healthy Japanese adults aged 40 to <80 who felt more forgetful with age; 58 completed (31 placebo, 27 PQQ).

study_contexts.study_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group trial, 12 weeks; primary endpoint Cognitrax cognitive battery.

dose.administration_frequency: Daily (split schedule not stated in the abstract).
dosage_forms: PQQ disodium salt powder product (delivery vehicle not reported in the abstract)
dose.reported_regimen: mnemoPQQ PQQ disodium salt 21.5 mg/day for 12 weeks versus placebo.

normalization.basis: Stated daily mass of PQQ disodium salt; no free-acid conversion.

source_provenance.location: PubMed abstract only; full text and the Table 4 correction (PMID 35917215) were not retrievable.

outcomes.name: Primary Cognitrax domains (composite memory, verbal memory, reaction time, complex attention, cognitive flexibility, executive function, motor speed) reported significantly improved versus placebo (abstract); effect sizes unverified and Table 4 later corrected.

limitations: Corrected-table hold (signed A135): a published correction (PMID 35917215) concerns Table 4 and its content was not retrieved, so primary results cannot be confirmed; direction recorded as unresolved.
Abstract only; no credit. Record-level scoring_eligible=false retained.
